title: iris lortetii var. samariae
intro: Iris lortetii var. samariae, commonly known as Samaria Iris, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the iris family (Iridaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Iris lortetii var. samariae include wound healing, anti-inflammatory responses, and antioxidant defense. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
